labels.name: BubbleChat
labels.explanation: Shows nearby player chat as floating speech bubbles above their heads for immersive LoM roleplay chat.

labels.name: CallBells
labels.explanation: Lets players opt into chat alerts when specific in-world bells are rung (e.g. calling staff/paladins).

labels.name: MagicSpells
labels.explanation: Fork of the MagicSpells Bukkit/Paper engine that powers LoM spells, items, and scripted mechanics.

labels.name: SlashMe
labels.explanation: Visual /me emote plugin so roleplay actions appear in-world (used on DvZ and LoM).

labels.name: SneakyAIController
labels.explanation: Tweaks mob pathfinding AI (e.g. zombies float vs drown) so hostile mobs behave better in LoM RP worlds.

labels.name: SneakyBagOfHolding
labels.explanation: Virtual bag-of-holding storage for MagicSpells items with category GUIs, capacity, and autopickup.

labels.name: SneakyCCTV
labels.explanation: In-game CCTV camera system for LoM surveillance/roleplay scenes.

labels.name: SneakyCasino
labels.explanation: Runs LoM casino minigames and related gambling mechanics.

labels.name: SneakyCastBar
labels.explanation: Displays casting progress bars for LoM spells and channeled abilities.

labels.name: SneakyCellPhones
labels.explanation: In-world cellphone logic for LoM (calls/apps bridging into the phone companion ecosystem).

labels.name: SneakyCharacterManager
labels.explanation: Lets players switch between multiple characters/identities on DvZ and LoM.

labels.name: SneakyConfigurableVoice
labels.explanation: Simple Voice Chat addon that sets voice hear-distance by permission (for races, roles, scenes).

labels.name: SneakyDiscordLink
labels.explanation: Links Minecraft accounts to Discord for community identity and Discord-gated features.

labels.name: SneakyDispatch
labels.explanation: Dispatch/call system for sending Paladins to incidents on LoM2.

labels.name: SneakyJobBoard
labels.explanation: Manages the LoM2 job board where players pick up and track available jobs.

labels.name: SneakyMail
labels.explanation: Player mail system for sending/receiving messages and item parcels.

labels.name: SneakyMannequins
labels.explanation: Interactive mannequin/skin customizer (layered outfits, hologram HUD) for LoM character looks.

labels.name: SneakyMisc
labels.explanation: Catch-all Paper plugin for small LoM mechanics that do not warrant their own plugin.

labels.name: SneakyNPCs
labels.explanation: Configurable NPC interaction layer: shops, quests, reputation, taxes, tailor menus, and more.

labels.name: SneakyNamegenerator
labels.explanation: Fantasy name generator for creating character/NPC names from templateable syllable lists.

labels.name: SneakyNotes
labels.explanation: Temporary floating TextDisplay notes players can place in the world for RP/signage.

labels.name: SneakyPersonalization
labels.explanation: Config-driven player preference dialogs exposed via PlaceholderAPI for personalized UX.

labels.name: SneakyPocketbase
labels.explanation: Paper bridge to PocketBase for persisting/syncing server data to the backend.

labels.name: SneakyPoses
labels.explanation: Sit/crawl/sleep pose commands with synced fake-player rendering for roleplay posing.

labels.name: SneakyPrototypeKit
labels.explanation: Admin toolkit to quickly prototype custom items/consumables with abilities without new plugins.

labels.name: SneakyRacials
labels.explanation: Implements LoM character racial abilities and race-specific mechanics.

labels.name: SneakyResourcePacks
labels.explanation: Server plugin that serves/manages multiple resource packs to connecting players.

labels.name: SneakySTTEvents
labels.explanation: Speech-to-text via Vosk + Simple Voice Chat that fires game events from spoken phrases.

labels.name: SneakyVaults
labels.explanation: Personal player vault inventories for storing items outside the main inventory.

labels.name: SneakyEntityTweaks
labels.explanation: Adjusts default entity behaviors for a roleplay environment.

labels.name: dippgen
labels.explanation: Manages regenerating blocks and ore veins so gatherable resources respawn on the server.

labels.name: Resourcepack
labels.explanation: Git-managed Minecraft resource pack assets shipped to players on Sneakymouse servers.

labels.name: Configuration
labels.explanation: No code change required. This is a config change in a plugin that we do not maintain.

labels.name: MagicSpells scripting
labels.explanation: YAML spell/item/script data that drives LoM MagicSpells content (skills, races, jobs, items, etc.).

labels.name: Navigation
labels.explanation: Quests/scrying/guide/navigation paths that did not show up (in specific areas).

labels.name: Mother Mouse Discord
labels.explanation: Community discord bot.
